about: Steeple Wyke: The Marrow Show. The people, and the 'look' text pasted word for word into every picture prompt that shows them, with their photographic reference sheet (sheets/<id>.png, made with gemini-3-pro-image). Every person is invented; no real person's likeness is wanted. Voices are ElevenLabs voice ids.
style: A real photograph, hyper-photorealistic, full-frame camera, 35mm lens, natural light, true skin texture with pores and lines, slight film grain, the muted natural colour of a British TV drama. Not an illustration, not a painting, not CGI, no captions.
place: Steeple Wyke, a Cotswold village of honey-coloured stone with a church spire, in July.

characters.name: DCI Hester Quaile
characters.role: Detective Chief Inspector. Judging the chutney. Wears a hearing aid in her left ear and switches it off when she does not want to hear.
characters.look: a 58-year-old white British woman with a short grey bob, reading glasses pushed up into her hair, a small beige hearing aid in her left ear, a lined, humorous face, wearing an olive waxed-cotton jacket over a navy crew-neck jumper, dark jeans and muddy green wellington boots

characters.name: DS Sam Adeyemi
characters.role: Detective Sergeant, nineteen days in the county, from London. The reader plays him.
characters.look: a 31-year-old Black British man with close-cropped hair and a short neat beard, tall and lean, wearing a navy rain mac over a white shirt and a loosened dark tie, grey trousers, polished brown leather city shoes, holding a small black police notebook

characters.name: Gerald Pike
characters.role: Chairman of the Horticultural Society for thirty-one years. Judges the marrows; his own has won for nine. The victim.
characters.look: a 72-year-old white British man, stout, with a ruddy face, bushy white eyebrows and a clipped white moustache, wearing a cream linen jacket, a pale blue shirt, a panama hat with a green-and-gold ribbon band and a red rosette on his lapel

characters.name: Margaret Pike
characters.role: Gerald's wife. Gardener. Forty-one foxgloves, none cut.
characters.look: a 68-year-old white British woman, thin and very upright, with silver hair in a loose bun and pale watchful eyes, wearing a quilted bottle-green gilet over a faded floral blouse, beige trousers, garden clogs, and red-handled secateurs on a cord round her neck

characters.name: The Reverend Clement Ashby
characters.role: Vicar of St Aldhelm's and treasurer of the Society. Took four thousand pounds from the prize fund for the church roof. The murderer.
characters.look: a 46-year-old white British man, slim, with thinning sandy hair and rimless glasses, wearing a black clerical shirt with a white dog collar under an unzipped bright yellow cycling jacket, black trousers with steel cycle clips at the ankle, black trainers

characters.name: Dilys Rudd
characters.role: The village butcher and Gerald's marrow rival. Injects water into her marrows.
characters.look: a 55-year-old white British woman, broad and strong, with curly hennaed red hair and freckled forearms, wearing a blue-and-white striped butcher's apron over a red checked flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, jeans and work boots, a pencil behind her ear

characters.name: Toby Pike
characters.role: Gerald's son, an estate agent in Cirencester. Wants forty houses on his father's fields. Was on the phone.
characters.look: a 36-year-old white British man with swept-back brown hair, a fresh tan and very white teeth, wearing a navy quilted gilet over a salmon-pink shirt, beige chinos and tan suede loafers without socks, a phone in his hand
